values.name: 10-Days Portfolio Sprint
values.description:
About the Sprint:
Are you tired of attending endless webinars and watching tutorials without actually building anything? Most engineering students and professionals have the skills but lack a Professional Portfolio to prove them.

CodeWithTechno (CWT) presents the 10-Days Portfolio Sprint—a high-intensity, execution-only challenge designed to transform you from a learner into a builder. This is not a workshop; it is an Execution Lab.

How it Works:
  • 10 Days, 10 Tasks: Every morning, you receive a specific design/dev task.
  • Proof of Work: You must submit your daily progress before the midnight deadline.
  • The "No-Work, No-Stay" Rule: To ensure a high-quality community, only those who submit their tasks will move to the next day.
  • Final Result: By Day 10, you will have a fully structured, industry-standard portfolio ready to show recruiters or clients.
What’s in it for You?
  • Tangible Outcome: A professional portfolio case study.
  • CWT Certification: Only for those who complete all 10 days.
  • Exclusive Networking: Access to a core group of serious builders.
  • Top Performers: Get featured on CWT social handles and an opportunity to join the CWT Core Team.
Rules:
  1. Commitment Fee: A nominal fee of ₹99 to ensure only serious participants enter.
  2. Deadline Discipline: Missing a submission means disqualification from the final rewards.
  3. Individual Participation: This is a solo sprint to build your personal brand.
Stop overthinking. Start executing. See you on Day 1.
values.tagline: Stop Watching, Start Building. 10 Days, 10 Components, 1 Final Portfolio.

values.name: VibeCon
values.description:
VibeCon: A Vibe Coding Competition Powered by TRAE AI

VibeCon is an innovative vibe coding competition hosted at Galgotias University, designed to redefine how developers approach problem solving and software creation. The event brings together students, developers, and innovators to explore a new paradigm of building software where creativity, rapid experimentation, and artificial intelligence play a central role. Unlike traditional coding contests that focus strictly on algorithms and syntax-heavy challenges, VibeCon encourages participants to transform ideas into functional prototypes while maintaining the natural momentum and creativity of development.

In a vibe coding competition, developers do not simply write code line by line in isolation. Instead, they collaborate with intelligent tools and iterate on ideas to rapidly build impactful solutions. At the center of this experience is TRAE AI, which serves as the primary technological partner, enabling participants to work alongside AI while developing their projects.

Key aspects of VibeCon include:

  • A focus on vibe coding, where creativity, intuition, and rapid prototyping drive the development process.

  • Integration of TRAE AI to assist participants with intelligent code generation, debugging, and development support.

  • Encouraging developers to build functional prototypes or innovative products within a limited time frame.

  • Promoting a human–AI collaborative workflow, where AI tools enhance productivity and idea exploration.

  • Providing a platform for students and developers to experiment with AI-assisted development environments.

  • Emphasizing innovation, creativity, and product thinking rather than only technical correctness.

Through this approach, VibeCon demonstrates how modern AI-powered development tools are transforming the way software is built. By combining human creativity with AI capabilities, the event highlights the evolving future of programming and offers participants an opportunity to experience the next generation of technology-driven innovation.

values.name: Dexterix 4.0
values.description:
Welcome to Dexterix 4.0, Galgotias University's premier hackathon! Organized in collaboration between Team TechnoJam, the Technical Club under GU Student Council, and the University’s School of Computing Science and Engineering, Dexterix 4.0 promises to be an exhilarating journey into the world of technology and innovation.

Building upon the success of its predecessors, Dexterix 4.0 invites participants from over 100+ colleges and universities across India to showcase their skills and creativity in a 36-hour coding marathon. This year, we are proud to introduce two tracks: corporate level and student level, opening doors for graduates and professionals in the tech industry to compete alongside students for exciting prizes and opportunities.

With the unwavering support of the School of Computing Science and Engineering, Dexterix 4.0 aims to push the boundaries of innovation and collaboration. From the bustling campus of GU to the guidance of esteemed faculty members, every aspect of Dexterix is fueled by the spirit of technological advancement.

Join us as we embrace the limitless possibilities of tech in Greater Noida and beyond. Together, let’s embark on a journey of creation, learning, and growth. From humble beginnings in 2019, Dexterix has become a beacon of inspiration for thousands, igniting passions and sparking entrepreneurial dreams.

As we launch into our fourth iteration, Dexterix 4.0 promises to surpass all expectations, delivering an experience that is bigger, better, and more transformative than ever before.

values.name: Hack Days in Delhi
values.description:
Hack Days Delhi is an exciting 12-hour innovation sprint bringing together developers, designers, founders, and tech enthusiasts to build impactful, real-world solutions. This fast-paced hackathon is designed to spark creativity, encourage collaboration, and help participants transform innovative ideas into working prototypes within a single day.

Participants will collaborate in teams, gain guidance from experienced mentors, and explore cutting-edge technologies while solving meaningful challenges. Whether you're a beginner looking to learn or an experienced developer aiming to showcase your skills, Hack Days Delhi offers the perfect platform to network, build, and grow in the tech ecosystem.

 Event Highlights

  • 12-hour high-energy hackathon
  • Mentorship from industry experts
  • Networking with developers, founders & innovators
  • Hands-on building and rapid prototyping
  • pitch your ideas and win exciting rewards

Tracks

1. Web3 Track
Build decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, or blockchain-based solutions. Explore areas like DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, and decentralized identity while solving real-world problems using Web3 technologies.

2. Business Requirements Document (BRD) Generation Agent
Create an AI-powered agent that can automatically generate structured Business Requirements Documents from raw inputs such as client conversations, notes, or problem statements. Focus on clarity, automation, and real-world usability for businesses and product teams.

3. Intelligent Data Dictionary Agent
Develop a smart system that can analyze datasets and automatically generate a comprehensive data dictionary. The solution should define data fields, types, relationships, and descriptions, making data more understandable and accessible for teams working with analytics and large datasets.

Who Should Join?

  • Developers (Frontend, Backend, Full Stack)
  • UI/UX Designers
  • AI/ML Enthusiasts
  • Startup Founders & Product Builders
  • Students and Tech Beginners

Why Join?

  • Learn by building in a real hackathon environment
  • Get mentorship and industry exposure
  • Enhance your portfolio with real projects
  • Connect with a like-minded tech community
  • Opportunity to win prizes and recognition

Join Hack Days Delhi and be part of a community that builds, innovates, and grows together. Turn your ideas into reality — all in just 8 hours!

values.name: Hackfest1.0
values.description: Hackfest 1.0 is an electrifying hybrid hackathon hosted by the CXI Club at MIET (Meerut Institute of Engineering & Technology), featuring a captivating healthcare theme. With two dynamic rounds, this event invites teams of 2 to 4 members to unleash their creativity and ingenuity. In Round 1, participants submit their innovative healthcare ideas via presentations online. The top 10 teams then advance to Round 2, an exhilarating offline competition where they prototype and refine their solutions. Guided by expert mentors and fueled by their passion for innovation, participants vie for top honors, showcasing groundbreaking ideas that have the power to transform the healthcare landscape. Hackfest 1.0 promises to be a thrilling journey of collaboration, innovation, and impact, shaping the future of healthcare one idea at a time.
